params.prompt: A premium full-bleed document closing-page background, portrait orientation, warm off-white (#FBF6EF) base with a single small, elegant gold (#C9A227) line-art kundli-chart glyph positioned in the lower corner only (much smaller and lighter-weight than a cover page would use), rest of the page calm and nearly blank with a very subtle indigo (#241E4E) thin border frame. Generous open space through the vertical and horizontal center for a closing message, support contact details, and legal/footer text to be overlaid later. Aesthetic: premium document closing page, calm, understated, NOT busy or mystical.
params.negative_prompt: zodiac wheel, cosmic swirl, cluttered pattern, dense graphics, dark heavy background, text, logo, low quality
